standards.applies_because: Outdoor enclosure next to water: IP67 target
Protection of potable water against backflow from the irrigation line
Electrical safety of the controller and its power supply

risks.risk: Valve fails open → flooding and water bill
risks.mitigation: Normally-closed valves, flow sensor with leak alarm, max run time in firmware
Backflow preventer (EN 1717 category per fluid) at the tap connection
Drain function, winter mode, frost-tolerant valve bodies

risks.risk: UV and heat degrade the enclosure
Weak Wi-Fi at the garden edge
risks.mitigation: External antenna or LoRa/BLE bridge option

tests.name: UV ageing 500 h
tests.method: Xenon-arc chamber, colour and impact after exposure

tests.name: Pressure / burst of valve manifold (1.5 × max supply)

prototype.method: FDM ASA 3D print (outdoor-stable) with an O-ring groove
steps: Bench the valve driver on a dev kit with a real latching valve
Print the housing in ASA with an O-ring lid
Assemble the quick-turn PCBA, pot the valve connector
Dunk test the closed housing (bench IPX7)
Run one real garden zone for a week with the flow sensor logging
